{{Short description|Published by Springer}}
{{italic title}}
The '''''International Encyclopedia of Statistical Science''''' is a statistical sciences reference published by Springer. It has been described as one of the scientific projects with the largest number of involved countries ever, since it includes contributors coming from 105 countries and six continents.<ref>[http://magazine.amstat.org/blog/2011/05/01/peace-through-statistics/ Review by Jürgen Symanzik, Utah State University, and Natascha Vukasinovic] (2011), ''AMSTATNEWS''.</ref> It contains the last papers written by [[Hirotugu Akaike]], Nobel Laureate Sir [[Clive Granger]], [[John Nelder]] and [[Erich Leo Lehmann]].<ref>{{Cite book |url=https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-3-642-04898-2 |page=xiv|doi=10.1007/978-3-642-04898-2 |title=International Encyclopedia of Statistical Science |date=2011 |isbn=978-3-642-04897-5 |editor-last1=Lovric |editor-first1=Miodrag }}</ref>

The team has been nominated for the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize by qualified nominators from Cambodia and Spain, with additional nominations anticipated <ref>{{Cite web|title=highlights-9-5-2025|url=https://www.radford.edu/news/2025/highlights-9-5-2025.html|website=Radford University|access-date=2025-11-27|language=en}}</ref>.

The first edition, in three volumes, was edited by [[Miodrag Lovrić]] and appeared in December 2010. It is published by [[Springer Science+Business Media|Springer]] and it is available in print and online form.
